title: Infinity State Transition Geometry Metadata (v1)
description: Optional visual geometry metadata for transition other_attributes keys arc, skew, base_pos, and arrow_pos. This schema validates the known geometry subset and is not part of core SCJSON validation.

x.description: Anchor x coordinate in canvas units.

y.description: Anchor y coordinate in canvas units.

LegacyPointString.description: Legacy coordinate string in the form "x,y".

arc.description: Transition curvature hint. 0 means straight; positive values increase curvature.

skew.description: Transition arc-center offset. 0 means midpoint; positive values shift toward the target end and negative values toward the source end.
